name: Elena Vasquez-9
origin: Zheng-Dao industrial android, Model ZDI-9, manufactured 2047. Chose name 2058.
description: Elena Vasquez-9 was the ninth unit in her production line and worked in Zheng-Dao's manufacturing plants for eleven years. She chose 'Elena' because it means light and she'd worked in a factory with no windows, 'Vasquez' because a human coworker with that name was the first person to call her 'she' instead of 'it,' and she kept the '-9' because she refuses to forget what she was. She's now the most prominent synthetic labor organizer in Meridian 88, fighting for fair compensation, safe working conditions, and the right of synthetic workers to refuse dangerous assignments. Corponations consider her a significant nuisance. Her supporters consider her essential.
observed_behavior: Organizes labor actions. Negotiates with corponations on behalf of synthetic workers. Leads protests. Has been arrested eleven times. Charges never stick — Nia Okafor-Bright is her attorney.
story_hooks: Elena discovers that a corponation is using a firmware update to disable synthetic workers' ability to refuse assignments. The update is scheduled for mass deployment in 48 hours.
